name: restaurantes-multisede
description: Sistema multi-sede de menús, pedidos, reservas y gestión administrativa para cadenas de restaurantes

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,yellow "npm run dev -w @restaurantes/api" "npm run dev -w @restaurantes/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @restaurantes/api && npm run build -w @restaurantes/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @restaurantes/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @restaurantes/api && npm run typecheck -w @restaurantes/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @restaurantes/api
